main.description: Declares XRPC methods available on a DID document service. The rkey is the service fragment ID without the # prefix (e.g., 'atproto_pds' for '#atproto_pds').

description.description: Description of what this service provides.

serviceType.description: The type of service being declared.

urlTemplates.description: URL templates for constructing web URLs from AT-URIs or record data. Useful for linking to web views of records.

authMethods.description: Authentication methods supported by this method.

deprecated.description: Whether this method is deprecated and should no longer be used.

lexicon.description: AT-URI pointing to a lexicon schema that defines this method.

collections.description: NSIDs of collections this URL template applies to.

description.description: Description of what this URL template is for.

url.description: URI template with placeholders for record data
